ways.label: Styx Road End to Arahura road end via Styx Saddle

start.name: Styx Road End car park, Dorothy Falls Road

evidence: From the carpark the route initially follows an old farm track.
The track begins at a car park about 500 m along the Dorothy Falls Road from the last road bridge across the Styx River and initially follows a rough 4WD route.

Once reached, cross this bridge to the true right bank of the Arahura River and follow the old logging road and river flats through private farmland before reaching the public road near the Milltown Bridge.

doubts: The page is titled as valley tracks, but describes one sequential trip from the Styx road end over Styx Saddle down the Arahura to the road end near Milltown Bridge, so I recorded it as one_way. The text does not say whether the trip can be walked in reverse. Start ref F2 (unnamed track at Dorothy Falls Road) chosen over F3, which is the Lake Kaniere Walkway. End ref F1 (track meets Milltown Road) matches 'public road near the Milltown Bridge'. The 'Extended trip' to Harman Hut, Lake Browning/Whakarewa and Browning Pass/Noti Raureka is an added day from the Styx Saddle junction, recorded as side trips. DOC's '11 km one way' seems short for the described trip.
